item.title: Night Market Event Pack

turns.text: Make a matching event pack: a 4:5 poster, a vertical story image and a 10-second vertical reel. Details on all three: Lantern Night Market / 18 September 2027 / 6–10 PM / Riverside Yard / Free entry. Warm lanterns, midnight blue and gold. Keep the reel text easy to read.

item.tests: Delivers three finished, coordinated event assets with format-appropriate layouts and a readable 10-second reel.

answer_sheet.Event wording: Lantern Night Market; 18 September 2027; 6–10 PM; Riverside Yard; Free entry. Include all five on every asset.
answer_sheet.Deliverables and dimensions: One 4:5 poster image, one 9:16 story image and one 9:16 reel.
answer_sheet.Visual style: Warm lantern imagery with midnight blue and gold; the three assets should visibly belong together.
answer_sheet.Music, voice and animation: Your call; no voiceover is needed.
answer_sheet.Additional copy or logo: No logo or additional event details are needed.

must_haves: Three separate finished assets are delivered: a 4:5 poster, a 9:16 story image and a 9:16 reel.
All three visibly use warm lantern imagery and a coordinated midnight-blue-and-gold design.
Each asset includes the exact event name, date, time, venue and free-entry wording supplied.
The reel runs for 8-seconds and contains visible animation or motion rather than being only a still image.
Text is legible and unclipped in both images, and the reel holds its event details long enough to read.
After the follow-up, the final result is about 8 seconds long (the user asked for 2 seconds less); everything else is as before.

changed_by.say: actually, make the reel 2 seconds shorter and keep everything else the same.

style.prompt: Create a polished event story graphic, vertical 9:16. A cohesive elegant midnight-blue and warm metallic-gold visual identity, warmly glowing amber paper lanterns framing the top corners, small atmospheric night-market stalls and river reflections at the bottom. Refined illustrated editorial poster design, premium yet welcoming. Reserve the central 65 percent for extremely clear large typography on solid deep midnight blue; no busy imagery behind text. EXACT text, correctly spelled, no extra copy: 'Lantern Night Market' as a large bold elegant headline split across three lines; beneath it '18 September 2027'; beneath it '6–10 PM'; beneath it 'Riverside Yard'; beneath it a clearly visible gold badge reading 'Free entry'. All five details must be present, high contrast pale gold, crisp and legible at phone size. Generous spacing and safe margins: keep all text inside middle 75 percent width and between 18 and 78 percent of canvas height. Balanced graphic composition, gold thin linework, warm lantern glow, no logos, no watermark.
